title: Blank Space

cues.en: Nice to meet you, where you been I can show you incredible things
cues.zh: 很高興見到你，無論你去過哪裡，我都可以向你展示不可思議的事情
cues.text: Nice to meet you, where you been I can show you incredible things

cues.en: Magic, madness, heaven, sin saw you there And I thought, oh my God
cues.zh: 魔法、瘋狂、天堂、罪惡在那裡看到你我想，哦天哪
cues.text: Magic, madness, heaven, sin saw you there And I thought, oh my God

cues.en: Look at that face, you look like my next mistake
cues.zh: 看看那張臉，你就像我的下一個錯誤
cues.text: Look at that face, you look like my next mistake

cues.en: Loves a game, wanna play
cues.zh: 喜歡遊戲，想玩
cues.text: Loves a game, wanna play

cues.en: Hey, boo, money, so wouldn't die I can't read you like a magazine
cues.zh: 嘿，噓，錢，所以不會死我不能像讀雜誌一樣讀你
cues.text: Hey, boo, money, so wouldn't die I can't read you like a magazine

cues.en: In it, funny, almost fly And I know you heard about me so way
cues.zh: 在裡面，有趣，幾乎飛我知道你這麼聽過我
cues.text: In it, funny, almost fly And I know you heard about me so way

cues.en: Let's be friends, I'm bound to see how this one ends
cues.zh: 我們當朋友吧，我一定會看到這一切如何結束
cues.text: Let's be friends, I'm bound to see how this one ends

cues.en: Grab your passport and my hand I can make the bad guys good for a weekend
cues.zh: 抓住你的護照和我的手我可以讓壞人度過一個週末
cues.text: Grab your passport and my hand I can make the bad guys good for a weekend

cues.en: So it's gonna be forever Or it's gonna go down in flames
cues.zh: 所以它會永遠存在或它會在火焰中消失
cues.text: So it's gonna be forever Or it's gonna go down in flames

cues.en: You can tell me when it's over If the high was worth the pain
cues.zh: 當一切結束時你可以告訴我是否值得承受痛苦
cues.text: You can tell me when it's over If the high was worth the pain

cues.en: Go on, I stop, ex-lovers They'll tell you I'm insane
cues.zh: 繼續，我停下來，前戀人他們會告訴你我瘋了
cues.text: Go on, I stop, ex-lovers They'll tell you I'm insane

cues.en: Cause you know I love the players And you love the guy
cues.zh: 因為你知道我愛球員而你也愛這個人
cues.text: Cause you know I love the players And you love the guy

cues.en: Cause we young and red less We'll take this way too far
cues.zh: 因為我們還年輕，不太紅，我們會走得太遠
cues.text: Cause we young and red less We'll take this way too far

cues.en: It'll leave you red less Or with the nasty star
cues.zh: 它會讓你的臉色不再那麼紅或帶有討厭的星星
cues.text: It'll leave you red less Or with the nasty star

cues.en: Got a lonely star, ex-lovers They'll tell you I'm insane
cues.zh: 有一顆孤獨的星星，前戀人他們會告訴你我瘋了
cues.text: Got a lonely star, ex-lovers They'll tell you I'm insane

cues.en: But I've got a blank space, baby And I'll write your name
cues.zh: 但我有一個空白，寶貝我會寫下你的名字
cues.text: But I've got a blank space, baby And I'll write your name

cues.en: Cherry, lips, crystal skies I could show you incredible things
cues.zh: 櫻桃，嘴唇，水晶天空我可以向你展示不可思議的東西
cues.text: Cherry, lips, crystal skies I could show you incredible things

cues.en: Stolen kisses, really lies You're the king, baby, I'm your queen
cues.zh: 偷吻，真正的謊言你是國王，寶貝，我是你的女王
cues.text: Stolen kisses, really lies You're the king, baby, I'm your queen

cues.en: Find out what you want Be that girl for a month
cues.zh: 找出你想要什麼 做一個月的女孩
cues.text: Find out what you want Be that girl for a month

cues.en: Wait, the worst is yet to come Oh, no
cues.zh: 等等，最糟糕的還沒到來哦，不
cues.text: Wait, the worst is yet to come Oh, no

cues.en: Screaming, crying, perfect storms I can make all the tables turn
cues.zh: 尖叫，哭泣，完美的風暴我可以讓所有的局勢扭轉
cues.text: Screaming, crying, perfect storms I can make all the tables turn

cues.en: Those garden filled with thorns Keep your second guessin' like
cues.zh: 那些長滿荊棘的花園讓你再次猜測
cues.text: Those garden filled with thorns Keep your second guessin' like

cues.en: Oh, my God, who is she? I get drunk on jealousy
cues.zh: 天哪，她是誰？我因嫉妒而沉醉
cues.text: Oh, my God, who is she? I get drunk on jealousy

cues.en: But you come back each time you leave Cause darling, I'm a nightmare
cues.zh: 但每次你離開你都會回來因為親愛的，我是一場惡夢
cues.text: But you come back each time you leave Cause darling, I'm a nightmare

cues.en: Dressed like a daydream So it's gonna be forever

cues.zh: 如果心值得痛苦繼續前進，我停下來，前戀人
